Class FeedforwardDependencyTrainer

java.lang.Object
opennlp.tools.depparse.FeedforwardDependencyTrainer
public final class FeedforwardDependencyTrainer extends Object
Trains the FeedforwardDependencyModel: oracle-derived transition examples, minibatch AdaGrad over a softmax cross-entropy loss, cube activation, and inverted dropout on the hidden layer, the training recipe of Chen and Manning (2014).

The hyperparameters are read from TrainingParameters: the keys of this class plus Parameters.ITERATIONS_PARAM for the number of epochs, Parameters.CUTOFF_PARAM for the minimum word frequency, QNTrainer.L2COST_PARAM for the L2 penalty on the dense weights (default 1.0E-8), and BeamSearch.BEAM_SIZE_PARAMETER for the refinement beam. Other keys are ignored.

Words below the frequency cutoff share the reserved unknown row, which is therefore trained only when such words exist; the unknown rows of the tag and label vocabularies keep their random initialization. Absent template positions share a trained padding row. Non-projective samples have no arc-standard derivation and are skipped. Training is deterministic for a fixed SEED_PARAM.

Since:
3.0.0

  • Method Details

    • train

      public static FeedforwardDependencyModel train(String languageCode, opennlp.tools.util.ObjectStream<opennlp.tools.depparse.DependencySample> samples, opennlp.tools.util.TrainingParameters parameters) throws IOException
      Trains a model from dependency samples.
      Parameters:
      languageCode - The ISO language code of the training data. Must not be null.
      samples - The training samples. Must not be null.
      parameters - The TrainingParameters. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A trained FeedforwardDependencyModel. Never null.
      Throws:
      IOException - Thrown if reading the samples fails.
      IllegalArgumentException - Thrown if a parameter is null, a hyperparameter is out of range, no trainable example can be derived from the samples, a vocabulary or the three vocabularies together exceed ResourceLimits.MAX_ENTRIES entries or a symbol as many UTF-8 bytes, or the network would store more than ResourceLimits.MAX_MATRIX_CELLS values.
      IllegalStateException - Thrown if an epoch produces a non-finite parameter.

    • refine

      public static FeedforwardDependencyModel refine(FeedforwardDependencyModel model, opennlp.tools.util.ObjectStream<opennlp.tools.depparse.DependencySample> samples, opennlp.tools.util.TrainingParameters parameters) throws IOException
      Refines a locally trained model with beam search and the early-update method of Collins and Roark (2004). The loss is conditional likelihood over candidate paths scored by summed log-probabilities.

      Refinement trains a copy with per-sentence AdaGrad steps and no dropout. Parameters.ITERATIONS_PARAM sets the number of passes and BeamSearch.BEAM_SIZE_PARAMETER the beam width, which the manifest of the result names as the beam size to parse it with. The vocabularies and the transition inventory of model are not extended, so the refined model carries the word cutoff of model.

      Parameters:
      model - The locally trained model. Not modified. Must not be null.
      samples - The training samples. Must not be null.
      parameters - The TrainingParameters; the epochs, learning rate, L2 penalty, seed, and beam size apply. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A new refined model, distinct from model. Never null.
      Throws:
      IOException - Thrown if reading the samples fails.
      IllegalArgumentException - Thrown if a parameter is null, a hyperparameter is out of range, the beam size is below 2, no trainable sample can be derived, or a sample requires a transition model does not know.
      IllegalStateException - Thrown if an epoch produces a non-finite parameter, or the network produces a non-finite transition score while a sentence is decoded.
